title: Chest Trauma: The Deadly Injuries and What the PCP Adds

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already seal open chest wounds, give oxygen, assist breathing and stabilize a flail chest. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Explain how chest injuries kill
  2. Tell apart tension pneumothorax, massive hemothorax and tamponade
  3. Know what the PCP adds in the BC chest trauma protocol, and its limits

Textbook: Chapter 26, PDF pages 2163–2231
slides.say: Welcome to Chapter twenty-six, chest trauma. As EMRs, you already seal an open chest wound, give high-flow oxygen, assist breathing with a bag-valve mask, and stabilize a flail chest. As a PCP, you need to know why each injury kills. Only head injuries cause more trauma deaths: about a quarter of trauma deaths come from the chest alone, and it contributes to another quarter. Today: how chest injuries kill, how to tell the deadliest ones apart at the bedside, and what the PCP adds in the BC chest trauma protocol, including what's not on your licensing exam.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到第二十六章，胸部创伤。作为 EMR，你们已经会封闭开放性胸部伤口、给高流量氧、用球囊面罩辅助通气、固定连枷胸。作为 PCP，你要知道每种损伤为什么致命。造成创伤死亡比胸伤更多的只有颅脑伤：约四分之一的创伤死亡单纯来自胸伤，另外四分之一胸伤是促成因素。今天讲：胸伤怎么致命；在床旁怎么区分最致命的几种；以及 BC 胸部创伤流程里 PCP 多做什么，包括哪些执照考试不考。

slides.title: Three ways the chest kills
slides.body:
Ventilationair or blood takes the space; pain stops deep breathspneumothorax, flail, rib fractures
Oxygenationdamaged lung can't pass O₂ into bloodpulmonary contusion
Circulationblood loss or a squeezed hearthemothorax, tamponade, tension

Any wound below the nipples is a chest and an abdominal injury.
slides.say: Chest injuries kill in three ways. The first is ventilation, moving air in and out. Air or blood in the pleural space takes room the lung needs, a broken chest wall can't move properly, and pain stops deep breaths. The second is oxygenation: a bruised, bleeding lung can't pass oxygen into the blood, even when air is moving. The third is circulation: blood can pour into the chest, or pressure can squeeze the heart so it can't fill. One more rule from the book: any wound below the nipples is both a chest and an abdominal injury, because the diaphragm moves up and down with each breath.
slides.sayZh: 胸部损伤有三条致命途径。第一是通气，也就是把气体吸进呼出：胸膜腔里的气体或血液占了肺需要的空间，胸壁断了动不起来，疼痛让病人不敢深呼吸。第二是氧合：挫伤出血的肺即使有气体进出，也没法把氧送进血液。第三是循环：血可能大量流进胸腔，或者压力挤住心脏让它充盈不了。书上还有一条规则：乳头平面以下的任何伤口，既是胸部伤也是腹部伤，因为膈肌随每次呼吸上下移动。

slides.title: Examine the chest like a PCP
slides.body:
1. Expose the chest
  2. Look: symmetry, wounds, paradoxical movement
  3. Feel: tenderness, crepitus, air under the skin, trachea
  4. Percuss: hyperresonant = air; dull = blood
  5. Listen: BC wants at least 6 points, front or back
  6. Neck veins, heart sounds; reassess a pneumothorax every 5 min
slides.say: As a PCP, your chest exam needs to be systematic every time. Expose the chest. Look for symmetry, bruises, wounds, and any section moving the wrong way. Feel for tenderness, crepitus, and subcutaneous emphysema, which is air under the skin that feels like popping bubble wrap, and check that the trachea is in the middle. Percuss: a drum-like, hyperresonant sound suggests air; a dull sound suggests blood. Listen to the lungs; BC wants at least six points on the front or six on the back. Check the neck veins and the heart sounds. And treat any suspected pneumothorax as unstable: reassess at least every five minutes.
slides.sayZh: 作为 PCP，你的胸部检查每次都要有系统。先暴露胸部。视诊：是否对称，有无瘀伤、伤口，有没有一块胸壁反着动。触诊：压痛、骨擦感和皮下气肿，也就是皮下有空气，摸起来像捏气泡膜；还要确认气管居中。叩诊：鼓音样的过清音提示有气，浊音提示有血。听诊：BC 要求前胸至少六个点或后背至少六个点。查颈静脉，听心音。凡是怀疑有气胸的都按不稳定处理，至少每五分钟复评一次。

slides.title: Ribs, flail chest and lung contusion
slides.body:
• Rib fractures: most common; ribs 4–9 break most often
  • Ribs 9–11 broken → think abdominal injury (liver, spleen)
  • Flail: 2+ adjacent ribs, each broken in 2+ places
  • The segment moves in on inhale, out on exhale
  • The real danger is the bruised lung beneath
  • Lung contusion can take up to 24 hours to show fully
slides.say: Rib fractures are the most common chest injury, and ribs four to nine break most often. A flail chest is two or more ribs side by side, each broken in two or more places. That segment floats free and moves the wrong way: in when the patient breathes in, out when they breathe out. But the real danger is the pulmonary contusion underneath, a bruised lung that bleeds and swells, so oxygen can't cross into the blood. It can take up to twenty-four hours to show fully. Give high-flow oxygen first, and assist ventilation if oxygen alone isn't enough.
slides.sayZh: 肋骨骨折是最常见的胸伤，最常断的是第四到第九肋。连枷胸是两根以上相邻肋骨各断两处以上，这一段胸壁游离出来、反着动：吸气时往里陷，呼气时往外凸。但真正危险的是下面的肺挫伤：肺被挫伤后出血水肿，氧气进不了血液。它可能要二十四小时才完全显现。先给高流量氧，单靠给氧不够时再辅助通气。

slides.title: Open pneumothorax: seal it
slides.body:
Gloved hand on the wound→occlusive dressing (3 sides) or chest seal→watch for tension
  • Hole larger than the glottis → air prefers the wound
  • Dressing about 3–4 times the wound size
  • High-flow O₂ whatever the SpO₂ (book)
  • Rarely becomes tension; if it does, relieve the seal
slides.say: An open pneumothorax is a hole in the chest wall that lets air into the pleural space. If the hole is bigger than the glottis, the opening between the vocal cords, air takes the easy path through the wound. Cover it at once with your gloved hand, then replace your hand with an occlusive dressing about three to four times the size of the wound, taped on three sides, or a commercial chest seal. Give high-flow oxygen whatever the saturation. It rarely turns into a tension pneumothorax, but the lung underneath may keep leaking. If tension signs develop, relieve the seal so the trapped air can escape.
slides.sayZh: 开放性气胸是胸壁上有个洞，让空气进入胸膜腔。如果洞比声门，也就是声带之间的开口还大，空气就会走伤口这条捷径。马上用戴手套的手盖住，再换成大小约为伤口三到四倍的封闭敷料，封三边，或用商品胸封。不管血氧多少都给高流量氧。它很少变成张力性气胸，但下面的肺可能还在漏气；一旦出现张力征象，就解除封闭，让困住的气体排出来。

slides.q: You sealed a stab wound to the right chest with a three-sided occlusive dressing. Five minutes later he is more short of breath, HR 132, BP falling, and breath sounds are absent on the right. As a PCP in BC, what is your next step?
options: Needle decompression at the second intercostal space
Lift the dressing to let the trapped air escape, then reassess
Tape down the fourth side so no more air gets in
Start CPAP to re-expand the lung
slides.say: Let's pause for a question. You sealed a stab wound to the right chest with a three-sided occlusive dressing. Five minutes later, the patient is more short of breath, his heart rate is one hundred thirty-two, his blood pressure is falling, and breath sounds are absent on the right. As a PCP in BC, what's your next step? A, needle decompression at the second intercostal space. B, lift the dressing to let the trapped air escape, then reassess. C, tape down the fourth side so no more air gets in. D, start CPAP to re-expand the lung. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 停一下考考你。你已经用三边封闭敷料封住了右胸的刺伤。五分钟后，病人呼吸更困难，心率一百三十二，血压在下降，右侧呼吸音消失。作为 BC 的 PCP，下一步做什么？A 在第二肋间做针刺减压；B 掀开敷料让困住的气体排出，然后复评；C 把第四边也贴上，不让空气再进去；D 上 CPAP 让肺重新张开。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. These are signs of a tension pneumothorax building under the dressing, and the BC protocol says to monitor for tension and relieve the seal if necessary. A is wrong because needle decompression isn't on the BC licensing exam, and in BCEHS it's an ACP skill; the exam answer is to relieve the seal. C would trap even more air. D is wrong: BC lists a suspected pneumothorax and a traumatic cause of breathing trouble as contraindications to CPAP.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。这是敷料下面正在形成张力性气胸的征象，BC 流程要求密切监测张力征象、必要时解除封闭。A 错，因为针刺减压执照考试不考，在 BCEHS 它也属于 ACP 技能；考试答案是解除封闭。C 会困住更多气体。D 错：BC 把疑似气胸和创伤性呼吸困难列为 CPAP 的禁忌症。

slides.title: Tension pneumothorax
slides.body:
One-way leak→pressure builds→mediastinum shifts→less blood back to the heart: shock
  • Absent breath sounds + hyperresonance on one side
  • Tachycardia, distended neck veins (JVD)
  • Tracheal shift and low BP are late: don't wait for them
  • Positive-pressure ventilation can cause it: ventilate gently

Shock + decreased breath sounds + hyperresonance on the same side = tension until proven otherwise.
slides.say: A tension pneumothorax happens when air leaks into the pleural space through a one-way valve: in, but never out. Pressure builds, the lung collapses, and the mediastinum is pushed to the other side. The big veins get squeezed, blood can't return to the heart, and the patient goes into shock. Look for absent breath sounds and hyperresonance on one side, a fast pulse, and distended neck veins. Tracheal deviation and low blood pressure are late, so don't wait for them. A key point for you now: positive-pressure ventilation can create or worsen a tension pneumothorax, so bag a chest-trauma patient with just enough pressure to see the chest rise.
slides.sayZh: 张力性气胸是空气通过一个单向活瓣漏进胸膜腔：只进不出。压力越积越高，肺塌陷，纵隔被推向对侧。大静脉被挤压，血回不到心脏，病人进入休克。要找的是：一侧呼吸音消失、叩诊过清音，脉搏快，颈静脉怒张。气管偏移和低血压都是晚期征象，别等它们出现。现在对你来说有一个关键点：正压通气可能造成或加重张力性气胸，所以给胸伤病人捏球囊时，用刚好看到胸廓起伏的压力就够了。

slides.title: Massive hemothorax
slides.body:
More than 1,500 mL of blood in the chest

  • = about 25–30% of blood volume → decompensated shock
  • Each side can hold about 3 L
  • One torn intercostal artery: up to 50 mL/min
  • Breathing trouble plus shock
  • Flat neck veins, trachea midline, dull to percussion
slides.say: A hemothorax is blood in the pleural space, and it's massive above one thousand five hundred millilitres. That's about twenty-five to thirty percent of an adult's blood volume, so the patient is already in decompensated shock. Each side of the chest can hold around three litres, so a patient can bleed to death into the chest without a drop showing outside. You'll see breathing trouble and shock together. What separates it from a tension pneumothorax: flat neck veins, because blood has been lost, a midline trachea, and dullness when you percuss. For the PCP, this is where the hypovolemia protocol comes in.
slides.sayZh: 血胸是胸膜腔里有血，超过一千五百毫升就是大量血胸。这相当于成人血容量的百分之二十五到三十，所以病人已经进入失代偿休克。每侧胸腔大约能装三升血，病人可能把血流干在胸腔里，外面一滴都看不到。你会同时看到呼吸困难和休克。和张力性气胸的区别在于：颈静脉塌陷，因为失血了；气管居中；叩诊浊音。对 PCP 来说，这正是低血容量流程派上用场的时候。

slides.title: Cardiac tamponade
slides.body:
• Usually penetrating; almost every stab wound to the heart
  • Sudden bleeding: as little as 50 mL can do it
  • Slow medical fluid: the sac stretches to 1,000–1,500 mL
  • Beck triad: muffled heart sounds, narrow pulse pressure, JVD
  • All three in only about 30%
  • Low BP + JVD + normal, equal lung sounds → think tamponade
slides.say: Cardiac tamponade is blood filling the pericardium, the sac around the heart. It's usually from a penetrating wound; almost every stab wound to the heart causes it. The sac can't stretch quickly, so in trauma as little as fifty millilitres can squeeze the heart, while slow medical fluid can reach a litre or more. The classic Beck triad is muffled heart sounds, a narrow pulse pressure, and distended neck veins, but only about thirty percent of patients show all three. A useful rule: low blood pressure and distended neck veins with normal, equal lung sounds point to tamponade. Give oxygen, start an IV, and move fast; the fix is in hospital.
slides.sayZh: 心包填塞是血液充满心包，也就是心脏外面的囊。通常由穿透伤造成，心脏被刺伤几乎都会发生。心包来不及撑大，所以创伤时只要五十毫升血就能压住心脏，而内科的慢性积液可以多到一升以上。经典的 Beck 三联征是心音遥远、脉压变窄、颈静脉怒张，但只有约百分之三十的病人三项俱全。实用规则：低血压加颈静脉怒张，但双肺呼吸音正常且对称，就要想到心包填塞。给氧、开静脉、快速转运，真正的处理在医院。

slides.title: Telling them apart
slides.body:
TensionHemothoraxTamponade
First signBreathing distressBreathing + shockShock
Neck veinsDistendedFlatDistended
TracheaShifts (late)MidlineMidline
Breath sounds↓ one side↓ one sideEqual
PercussionHyperresonantDullNormal

Muffled heart sounds point to tamponade; in tension they are usually normal.
slides.say: Let's put the three side by side, because exams love this comparison. A tension pneumothorax usually shows breathing distress first, with distended neck veins, decreased breath sounds and hyperresonance on one side, and a trachea that shifts late. A massive hemothorax gives breathing trouble and shock together, with flat neck veins, decreased breath sounds and dullness on one side, and a midline trachea. Tamponade shows shock first, with distended neck veins, but equal breath sounds, normal percussion, a midline trachea, and muffled heart sounds. You don't need a final diagnosis to know a patient is critical, but these clues tell you what to expect and what to report.
slides.sayZh: 把三种放在一起比，考试特别爱考。张力性气胸通常先表现为呼吸窘迫，颈静脉怒张，一侧呼吸音减弱、叩诊过清音，气管偏移出现得晚。大量血胸是呼吸困难和休克同时出现，颈静脉塌陷，一侧呼吸音减弱、叩诊浊音，气管居中。心包填塞先表现为休克，颈静脉怒张，但两侧呼吸音对称、叩诊正常、气管居中、心音遥远。不需要最终诊断就能判断病人危重，但这些线索告诉你该预期什么、该报告什么。

slides.q: A man was stabbed just left of the sternum. BP 76/58, HR 130, neck veins distended, breath sounds equal on both sides, percussion normal, heart sounds hard to hear. What is the most likely injury?
slides.say: Here's another one. A man was stabbed just to the left of the sternum. His blood pressure is seventy-six over fifty-eight and his heart rate is one hundred thirty. His neck veins are distended, breath sounds are equal on both sides, percussion is normal, and the heart sounds are hard to hear. What's the most likely injury? A, tension pneumothorax. B, massive hemothorax. C, cardiac tamponade. D, simple pneumothorax. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 再来一题。一名男子胸骨左侧被刺伤，血压七十六比五十八，心率一百三十，颈静脉怒张，两侧呼吸音对称，叩诊正常，心音很难听清。最可能是什么损伤？A 张力性气胸；B 大量血胸；C 心包填塞；D 单纯气胸。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is C, cardiac tamponade. Low blood pressure with a narrow pulse pressure, distended neck veins, and muffled heart sounds after a stab wound near the heart fit tamponade, and equal breath sounds with normal percussion argue against a pneumothorax. A tension pneumothorax would give decreased breath sounds and hyperresonance on one side. A massive hemothorax would give flat neck veins and dullness. A simple pneumothorax doesn't cause this degree of shock.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 C，心包填塞。心脏附近刺伤后出现低血压伴脉压变窄、颈静脉怒张、心音遥远，符合心包填塞；两侧呼吸音对称、叩诊正常，不支持气胸。张力性气胸会有一侧呼吸音减弱和过清音；大量血胸会有颈静脉塌陷和叩诊浊音；单纯气胸不会造成这种程度的休克。

slides.title: Hidden killers: aorta and heart
slides.body:
• Aortic tear: found in 1 in 5 blunt trauma deaths; fast deceleration
  • Pain behind the sternum or between the shoulder blades
  • Right arm pulse and BP stronger than left arm and legs
  • Myocardial contusion: over 30 km/h; unexplained sinus tachycardia
  • Commotio cordis: blow to the chest → VF; shock within 2 min
slides.say: Some chest killers hide. A torn aorta is found in about one in five deaths from blunt trauma, usually after fast deceleration, like a high-speed crash or a fall from height. Check pulses in all four limbs: the right arm may have a stronger pulse and higher pressure than the left arm and the legs. A myocardial contusion, a bruised heart, can happen at speeds over thirty kilometres per hour; a clue is a sinus tachycardia that blood loss doesn't explain. And commotio cordis is a blow to the chest at the wrong moment of the heartbeat. It causes ventricular fibrillation, and defibrillation within two minutes works well.
slides.sayZh: 有些胸部致命伤是隐藏的。约五分之一的钝伤死亡者有主动脉撕裂，通常发生在快速减速之后，比如高速车祸或高处坠落。四肢脉搏都要查：右臂的脉搏可能比左臂和双腿更强、血压更高。心肌挫伤，也就是心脏被撞伤，车速超过每小时三十公里就可能发生；线索是失血解释不了的窦性心动过速。心脏震荡是胸部在心跳的错误时刻受到一击，会引起室颤，两分钟内除颤效果很好。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the BC Chest Trauma protocol
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Control bleeding with gauze (no packing)
  • Assist oxygenation and ventilation
  • 3-sided occlusive dressing or chest seal
  • Watch for tension; relieve the seal if needed
  • Manually stabilize a flail chest
  • Position the patient ASAP

PCP adds (en route)

  • Vascular access if required
  • TXA if indicated: 2 g IV over 1 min
  • Shock: hypovolemia protocol, 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL

Needle decompression is not on the licensing exam (licence: optional Schedule 2 endorsement; BCEHS H06: an ACP intervention).
slides.say: Here is the BC chest trauma protocol. On the left is every licence level: control bleeding with gauze, remembering that BC doesn't allow packing chest wounds; assist oxygenation and ventilation if needed; seal an open chest wound with a three-sided occlusive dressing or a commercial chest seal, watching closely for tension and relieving the seal if necessary; manually stabilize a flail chest; and position the patient as soon as possible. On the right is what the PCP adds en route: vascular access if required, and TXA if indicated, two grams IV over one minute. Needle decompression isn't on your licensing exam; the licence rules allow it as an optional endorsement, but BCEHS currently lists it as an ACP intervention.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的胸部创伤流程。左栏是所有执照级别：用纱布控制出血，记住 BC 不允许填塞胸部伤口；必要时辅助氧合和通气；用三边封闭敷料或商品胸封封住开放性胸部伤口，密切观察张力征象，必要时解除封闭；用手固定连枷胸；尽快摆好病人体位。右栏是 PCP 在途中多做的：需要时建立静脉通路；有指征时给 TXA，两克静脉推注、一分钟推完。针刺减压执照考试不考；执照法规把它列为可选的附加授权（Schedule 2），但 BCEHS 现行指引（H06）把它列为 ACP 的处置。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Needle decompression: not on the exam → relieve the seal
  • Flail: book drops external stabilization → BC: manually stabilize
  • Lung sounds: at least 6 points, front or back
  • Opioid pain relief: not on the exam (BCEHS: ACP drugs)
  • Book's sedation and paralytic drugs: not on the BC exam drug list
slides.say: Now the book-versus-BC differences; on the BC exam, BC wins. The book teaches needle decompression step by step. It isn't on the BC licensing exam, and in BCEHS it's an ACP skill, so your exam tools for tension are relieving the seal, oxygen, gentle ventilation, and fast transport. The book says external stabilization of a flail segment is no longer recommended; the BC protocol still lists manual stabilization of the flail chest for every licence level, so do what the protocol says. BC wants lung sounds at at least six points, front or back. The book's opioid pain relief isn't on the exam either, and in BCEHS opioids are ACP drugs, while its sedation and paralytic drugs for intubation aren't on the BC exam drug list.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲书和 BC 的不同，在 BC 考试里以 BC 为准。书上一步步教针刺减压；BC 执照考试不考这项，在 BCEHS 它属于 ACP 技能，所以考试时你处理张力的手段是解除封闭、给氧、轻柔通气和快速转运。书上说已不再推荐从外部固定连枷段；BC 流程仍然要求所有执照级别用手固定连枷胸，所以照流程做。BC 要求肺部听诊至少六个点，前胸或后背。书上的阿片类镇痛执照考试也不考（在 BCEHS 阿片类是 ACP 用药），书上插管用的镇静药和肌松药也不在 BC 考纲药物范围内。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• IV en route; never delay transport for a line
  • Lung contusion: go easy on fluid; aortic tear: give it slowly
  • TXA: not after 3 h, not under 12; push over 1 min
  • CPAP contraindicated: trauma, suspected pneumothorax
  • Entonox: not with a pneumothorax
  • Chest trauma + shock: only 1 in 4 bleed mainly in the chest
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch out for at PCP level. First, the IV goes in en route; a line is never a reason to stay on scene. Second, fluids need thought: with a lung contusion, the book says to be stingy unless there's shock, and with a suspected aortic tear, give fluid gradually. Third, TXA: not more than three hours after injury, not under age twelve, and push it over one minute. Fourth, BC lists a traumatic cause of breathing trouble and a suspected pneumothorax as contraindications to CPAP. Fifth, Entonox is contraindicated with a pneumothorax. And in chest trauma with shock, only one patient in four is bleeding mainly into the chest, so search everywhere.
slides.sayZh: PCP 层面新的注意事项。第一，静脉通路在途中开，开静脉永远不是留在现场的理由。第二，补液要动脑：肺挫伤时，书上说除非有休克，否则要少补；怀疑主动脉撕裂时要慢慢补。第三，TXA：受伤超过三小时不给，未满十二岁不给，推注要一分钟推完。第四，BC 把创伤性呼吸困难和疑似气胸列为 CPAP 的禁忌症。第五，有气胸时禁用笑气。还有，胸部创伤合并休克的病人，只有四分之一主要出血在胸腔里，所以要全身找。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Chest injuries kill via ventilation, oxygenation, circulation
  2. Tell them apart: neck veins, breath sounds, percussion
  3. BC: seal, relieve tension, hold the flail; PCP adds IV + TXA en route

Next: Chapter 27 — abdominal injuries
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: chest injuries kill through ventilation, oxygenation, and circulation, and many patients have more than one problem. Two: learn the bedside differences. Tension pneumothorax has distended neck veins with one-sided decreased breath sounds and hyperresonance; massive hemothorax has flat neck veins and dullness; tamponade has distended neck veins, equal breath sounds, and muffled heart sounds. Three: under the BC chest trauma protocol, everyone seals open wounds, relieves the seal if tension develops, and manually stabilizes a flail chest. The PCP adds vascular access and TXA en route, and needle decompression isn't on your licensing exam. Next lesson: Chapter twenty-seven, abdominal injuries. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 最后三句话。一，胸部损伤通过通气、氧合、循环三条途径致命，很多病人不止一个问题。二，记住床旁的区别：张力性气胸是颈静脉怒张加一侧呼吸音减弱和过清音；大量血胸是颈静脉塌陷和叩诊浊音；心包填塞是颈静脉怒张、两侧呼吸音对称、心音遥远。三，按 BC 胸部创伤流程，所有人都要封闭开放伤口、出现张力时解除封闭、用手固定连枷胸；PCP 在途中多做静脉通路和 TXA，针刺减压执照考试不考。下节课讲第二十七章，腹部损伤。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
